# montecarlo_bi_container (Data Source)

A BI container groups the connections Monte Carlo uses to monitor one BI tool: a Looker instance, a Tableau site, a Power BI tenant or a custom BI connector. It runs on a deployment, and every connection added to it goes through that deployment. `deployment_id` is required for Looker, Tableau and Power BI. A `custom-bi-connector` container takes the deployment of the agent that registered the connector, or none for a push-only connector, whose BI assets are pushed to Monte Carlo.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bi_container_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `created_time` (String) When the BI container was created.
- `deployment_id` (String) The deployment the container's connections run through. Null for a container with no deployment, such as a push-only custom BI connector's. The id may name a deployment on Monte Carlo's older collection platform. The deployments endpoints do not list those.
- `deployment_name` (String) Display name of the deployment. Null exactly when `deployment_id` is.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the BI container.
- `name` (String) Display name of the BI container. Null for a container that was never named.
- `type` (String) The BI tool the container represents. Fixed once created.
